desc: Derive and verify the factorization N = d·(3y² + 3dy + d²) with d = x−y, and prove the bound d³ < N so d ≤ N^(1/3) ≤ 10^6.

Implement the complete Python solution: integer cube root with adjustment loops, loop d from 1 to cbrt(N), check N % d == 0, compute m, D = 12m − 3d², isqrt perfect-square check, (s − 3d) % 6 == 0 and positivity, output first (x, y) or -1.
Validate edge cases mentally: N=1 → -1, N=397 → (12,11), large N near 10^18 with pure-integer arithmetic, and confirm O(10^6) runtime is acceptable.
